claim: Test whether the frozen 512-byte causal window is the shared cause of dialogue-support loss and tiny prompt-conditioned collapse before any new 303M or IIT-mouth coupling run.

fixed_source.eligibility: reviewed, non-deleted, non-synthetic human messages with alternating prompter/assistant ancestry
fixed_source.panel_contamination: fail closed on exact prompt occurrence

data_views.selection: deduplicate exact documents, sort by SHA-256 and take the first N without result-dependent curation

tiny_model_test.schedule: 100-step linear warmup then cosine to 0.1 peak ratio
tiny_model_test.answer_ce: off in all arms; V0/V2 already measured V2 as inferior, so context is the only changed training axis

arms.V1_short_2048: the identical short views, block 2048, batch 2
arms.V1_long_2048: the preregistered long views excluded by block 512, block 2048, batch 2

tiny_model_test.common_probe: first eight SHA-ordered short training documents
tiny_model_test.long_probe: first eight SHA-ordered long training documents

gates.heldout_descent: all arms finish below their own initial held-out CE
gates.short_prompt_conditioning: V1_short_2048 yields at least 6/8 non-empty, six distinct, structurally valid responses
gates.short_target_recovery: V1_short_2048 recovers the first 16 UTF-8 target bytes on at least 6/8 probes and exceeds V0_short_512
gates.long_prompt_conditioning: V1_long_2048 yields at least 6/8 non-empty, six distinct, structurally valid responses
gates.long_target_recovery: V1_long_2048 recovers the first 16 UTF-8 target bytes on at least 6/8 probes

promotion.303m_single_seed: allowed only after every census, integrity and tiny V1 gate passes
promotion.r4_meaningful_mouth: remains blocked until a separately preregistered 303M single-seed conversation pass

failure_policy.if_census_or_integrity_fails: record failure and do not rent GPU
failure_policy.if_tiny_gate_fails: record and preserve raw evidence; do not run 303M or couple IIT state
